The 22nd Zee Cine Awards ceremony, presented by Zee Entertainment Enterprises, honoured the best Hindi films of 2023. The event was held on 10 March 2024 in Mumbai, India, with the telecast airing on 16 March 2024 on Zee TV, Zee Cinema, and streaming on ZEE5. Hosted by Ayushmann Khurrana and Aparshakti Khurrana.
The awards included distinctions between Viewers' Choice and Jury/Critics/Technical categories. Films such as Jawan, Pathaan, Gadar 2, Mrs. Chatterjee vs Norway, and Satyaprem Ki Katha dominated the night. Jawan emerged as one of the biggest winners in technical and jury categories, while Gadar 2 topped Viewers' Choice for Best Film.
Winners and nominees
Viewers' Choice Awards
*Best Film: Gadar 2
*Best Actor – Male: Sunny Deol for Gadar 2
*Best Actor – Female: Kiara Advani for Satyaprem Ki Katha
Jury/ Main Awards
*Best Film: Jawan
*Best Director: Atlee for Jawan
*Best Actor – Male (Popular): Shah Rukh Khan for Jawan and Pathaan
*Best Actor – Female (Popular): Rani Mukerji for Mrs. Chatterjee vs Norway
*Best Supporting Actor - Male: Anil Kapoor for Animal
*Best Supporting Actress: Dimple Kapadia for Pathaan (among nominees including Triptii Dimri for Animal, Yami Gautam for OMG 2)
*Best Actress (Jury/Critics): Alia Bhatt for Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani
*Best Background Score: Anirudh Ravichander for Jawan
*Best Action: Spiro Razatos, Anal Arasu, Craig Macrae, and team for Jawan
*Best VFX: Red Chillies Entertainment for Jawan
*Best Story: Jawan
*Best Music: Jawan
*Best Dialogue: Jawan (technical win noted)
